copy.tagline: 把 Linear 问题评论同步成聊天对话

copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want Linear discussions to land directly in chat.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会把 Linear 接进 NanoClaw:它会参与议题的评论线程,某条评论一发就回应,不需要 @ 提及。每个议题的评论线程各自成为一个独立会话。设置时需要你提供 OAuth 凭据或 Personal API key、webhook 签名密钥和团队 key。
howto.when: 当你在 Linear 某个受监控团队的议题下出现新评论时,Claude 会自动接管回应,无需 @ 提及。配置阶段,当你要接入 Linear 频道、填凭据或排查评论没送达时也会用到它。

say.text: 帮我把 Linear 的 ENG 团队接入 NanoClaw
say.note: 它会读取团队 key 并把该团队议题接到指定 agent

say.text: Linear 用 Personal API key 配置,跳过 OAuth
Linear 评论一直没到 agent,帮我查 webhook

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude joins Linear issue comment threads on the selected team and replies to every comment — no @-mention needed. Each issue's comment thread becomes its own isolated conversation. Setup needs OAuth credentials or a Personal API key, a webhook signing secret, and the team key.
howto.when_en: It takes over when a new comment appears on an issue in the watched Linear team, with no @-mention required. It also runs while you wire the Linear channel, enter credentials, or debug comments that never arrive.

say_en.text: Connect my Linear ENG team to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Reads the team key and routes that team's issues to an agent

say_en.text: Set Linear up with a Personal API key, skip OAuth
say_en.note: Answer none at both OAuth prompts, then set LINEAR_API_KEY in .env

say_en.text: Linear comments never reach the agent, check the webhook
say_en.note: It verifies webhook URL, team, Comment event, and signing secret
